title: Researchers Publish Security Analysis of Bitcoin’s Post-Quantum SHRINCS Proposal
summary:
Bitcoin Magazine

Researchers Publish Security Analysis of Bitcoin’s Post-Quantum SHRINCS Proposal

Blockstream researchers published a 131-page security analysis of SHRINCS, a hash-based post-quantum signature scheme for Bitcoin, and are asking the community to review it for flaws.

This post Researchers Publish Security Analysis of Bitcoin’s Post-Quantum SHRINCS Proposal first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman.

summary:

U.S. Treasury Secretary Pushes Back on Bigger Fed Hike

Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent urged the Fed not to embrace a bigger rate hike as Citi and traders still see a quarter-point move in December and bitcoin fell below $60,000.

title: Bitcoin Price Crashes to $59,000 as Market Selloff Deepens
summary:

Bitcoin Price Crashes to $59,000 as Market Selloff Deepens

Bitcoin fell below $60,000 for the first time since early July on Friday as a tech stock rout, rate hike bets and record ETF outflows hit risk assets.

This post Bitcoin Price Crashes to $59,000 as Market Selloff Deepens first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman.

title: Block Says Most Bitcoin Payments on Square Are for Coffee and Food
summary:
Bitcoin Magazine

Block Says Most Bitcoin Payments on Square Are for Coffee and Food

Block’s first bitcoin payments report found the median Square payment is about $13, with 72% at food and drink businesses, as it pushes for a de minimis tax exemption.

This post Block Says Most Bitcoin Payments on Square Are for Coffee and Food first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman.

title: Bitcoin Hovers Just Above Average Holder’s Cost Basis as Price Keeps Dipping
summary:
Bitcoin Magazine

Bitcoin Hovers Just Above Average Holder’s Cost Basis as Price Keeps Dipping

Bitcoin is trading barely above its realized price, the average cost of every coin, and a break below would put the average holder at a loss for the first time since early 2023.

This post Bitcoin Hovers Just Above Average Holder’s Cost Basis as Price Keeps Dipping first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman.
